data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6117 opened 2019 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 57.6m (2018). Analysis of the claims development triangle shows a favourable prior-year development of GBP 4.4m (a release), driven primarily by improvement on the 2017 underwriting year and resulting in a reported surplus of GBP 6.2m at 2019 year end. The syndicate's business is written as reinsurance acceptances (treaty).
raw_causal_phrases: In 2019 the surplus was GBP 6.2m (2018 the surplus was GBP 6.1m).
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, 2018 column). Prior-year development derived from the gross claims development table (claims triangle) by comparing the 2017 column current estimate to its previous diagonal (one year earlier) producing a GBP 4.4m favourable movement (release). The 2017 underwriting year had closed/reinsured to the host syndicate in the underwriting year accounts context; RITC activity is noted elsewhere in the report and may distort some comparatives but the triangle values were used as primary source. No explicit single-line 'movement in prior years' gross figure was presented; a net surplus sentence was present and is quoted verbatim.
